verdict.rationale: Beamer is a hosted changelog and in-app notification service, and buyers of such tools can fairly ask whether it can be self-hosted, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premises or open-source deployment. Installing it via 'a simple embed code or Wordpress plugin' only drops the hosted widget into your own app, which is not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
